witness.title: The Septuagint Version of the Old Testament: According to the Vatican Text, Translated into English
witness.repository_or_publisher: Lancelot Charles Lee Brenton; local text captured from eBible.org
witness.editorial_policy: Historical English wording and source labels are retained, including lettered verse labels and translator/editor notes.

coverage.structure_description: 50 chapter pages; 1,532 English labels, including lettered labels.
coverage.supplements_and_editorial_signs: Translator/editor notes and source notation are retained in the local reader record.
coverage.numbering_policy: Printed labels are preserved. Shared labels with the Geʽez layer are navigation aids, not verified one-to-one equivalents.

rights.statement: The cited eBible.org source identifies Brenton's 1851 English translation as public domain. This claim is separate from rights in the Geʽez transcription and any source website presentation.
rights.territory_or_term_limits: Public-domain status is recorded for this historical English translation; it does not clear other editions or layers.

review_dimensions.scope: Captured source pages for chapters 1–50, with ordered, nonempty labels and retained notes.
review_dimensions.notes: Checks capture inventory and ordering, not an independent collation against the 1851 print edition.

review_dimensions.scope: No fresh review against the Greek Septuagint or Brenton's printed edition.
review_dimensions.notes: The English text is identified as translated from Greek, not from the bundled Geʽez transcription.

review_dimensions.scope: The historical translation's cited public-domain status.
review_dimensions.notes: The conclusion applies to Brenton's translation only, not the other text layers in this archive.

additional_notes: This is a Greek-to-English translation layer from a distinct Septuagint work. It is paired in the reader with the EOTC Geʽez Genesis transcription for navigation; no EOTC edition membership or textual identity is asserted.
